claims.content: To browse and search for products to find items of interest.

goal.raw_text: To browse and search for products to find items of interest.

claims.content: The user has accessed the JTVauctions.com website.
The Auction Site is operational and accessible via a web browser.
The Customer accesses the JTVauctions.com website and interacts with the Global Header Components (such as the Search box or Navigation Menu) to initiate a product search or browse a category.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer accesses the JTVauctions.com website and interacts with the Global Header Components (such as the Search box or Navigation Menu) to initiate a product search or browse a category.

claims.content: The Customer accesses the JTVauctions.com homepage or any internal page containing the Global Header.
The Customer chooses one of two primary navigation methods: using the 'Search' box in the header or selecting a category from the 'Navigation' menu.
If searching: The Customer enters keywords into the search box and clicks 'Go'.
If browsing: The Customer hovers over or clicks a top-level category (e.g., Jewelry, Gemstones) to reveal sub-categories and selects a specific interest.
The system displays the 'Search Results' page (for searches) or the 'Category Landing Page' (for browsing), presenting a list of matching products.
The Customer reviews the product listings, utilizing sorting options (e.g., Price Low-High, Time Left) or filtering tools (if available) to refine the results.
The Customer clicks on a specific product thumbnail or title to view the 'Product Details Page'.
The system loads the Product Details Page, displaying comprehensive information including images, descriptions, current bid status, and auction end time.
The Customer enters a search term that yields no results. The system displays a 'No Results Found' message and suggests alternative search terms or categories.
The Customer selects a category that has no active auctions or products currently listed. The system displays a message indicating no items are available in that category at this time.

The Customer attempts to sort or filter results, but the functionality is temporarily unavailable or returns an error. The system displays the default unsorted/unfiltered list with a notification about the temporary issue.

The Customer clicks on a product link, but the auction for that item has already ended or been removed. The system redirects the user to a generic 'Item Not Available' page or the homepage, informing them the item is no longer accessible.
